symbols.name: HttpRepresentationHeaders
symbols.summary: Evaluates request conditions and a single byte range against an already selected representation.
symbols.remarks: The caller supplies authoritative existence, a strong entity tag and the last-modified timestamp. The caller authorizes access, selects content, and applies mutation conditions atomically.

symbols.name: Evaluate(HttpRequest, bool, string, DateTimeOffset, bool)
symbols.summary: Evaluates If-Match, If-Unmodified-Since, If-None-Match and If-Modified-Since in precedence order.

syntax.content: public static HttpRepresentationPreconditionOutcome Evaluate(HttpRequest request, bool exists, string entityTag, DateTimeOffset lastModified, bool read)

parameters.description: The request containing conditional headers.
Whether the selected representation exists.
Its current strong, quoted entity tag, or null when it does not exist.
Its last modification timestamp. HTTP dates compare at whole-second precision.
Whether this is a read, where a matching validator can produce a not-modified response.

returns.description: The decision before delivering content or attempting an atomic mutation.

symbols.name: SelectRange(HttpRequest, long, string, DateTimeOffset)
symbols.summary: Selects one contiguous byte range, or the full representation when Range is absent or If-Range does not match.
symbols.remarks: If-Range accepts one matching strong entity tag or an exact last-modified date at whole-second precision. The byte range unit is case insensitive. Multiple ranges are unsupported.

syntax.content: public static HttpRepresentationRangeSelection SelectRange(HttpRequest request, long length, string entityTag, DateTimeOffset lastModified)

parameters.description: The request containing Range and optional If-Range headers.
The nonnegative length of the selected representation in bytes.
Its current strong, quoted entity tag.
Its last modification timestamp, compared at whole-second precision.

returns.description: A full or partial selection, or an unsupported or unsatisfiable range classification.

returns.description: A full or partial selection, or an unsupported or unsatisfiable range classification.
